title: Reusable food service ware: collection, washing and return
scope_note: Principles for reusing tableware designed for repeated use. Not a safety certification of an item from a photo.

title: Reusable tableware and sorting at the source
scope_note: An example of a local policy that encourages reusable tableware. It isn't an acceptance rule for facilities across Indonesia.

title: Reducing and Reusing Basics (2021 archive)
scope_note: General principles for reuse, repair, and donation. Not a technical fitness standard for every item.

title: Waste prevention, reuse and recycling
scope_note: About preventing the next purchase or use. It doesn't prove how much the user has already reduced.

title: How Do I Recycle Common Recyclables
scope_note: General material guidance. The type and cleanliness of an item don't guarantee that a local facility accepts it.

title: Used Household Batteries
scope_note: The battery type decides the procedure. Send batteries to a specialist collector, not a regular recycling bin.

title: Electronics Donation and Recycling
scope_note: Manufacturer and handler programs for electronics, and data protection. Acceptance and procedures still need a local check.

title: Sustainable Management of Food Basics
scope_note: Preventing food waste and managing organic scraps. A photo can't establish that food is safe to eat.

title: Household Hazardous Waste: safe management
scope_note: Don't mix or dump chemical waste. Follow the label and ask your local handler.

title: Broken glass: protective packaging and rubbish route
scope_note: An example of putting broken glass in residual waste with wrapping and a label. Not an Indonesian acceptance rule.

title: Plastic toothbrushes and toothbrush heads
scope_note: Manual plastic toothbrushes only. Doesn't extend to electric toothbrushes, batteries, or all plastics.

title: Household rubbish: crockery and broken glass
scope_note: An example of a jurisdiction that puts ceramics in household residual waste. Check your local rules.

title: Kitchen knives: specialist metal collection
scope_note: Metal kitchen knives go to a specialist handler with the blade protected. Not medical waste and not for regular bins.

title: Manurewa Community Recycling Centre: scissors
scope_note: An example of a center that accepts scissors. Service in the user's area hasn't been verified.

title: Choosing Packaging Wisely: understanding plastic codes
scope_note: Resin codes identify the material. They don't prove food-contact safety, fitness for reuse, or recycling acceptance.

title: Recycle City: Materials Recovery Center
scope_note: Education on PET resin 1 and HDPE resin 2. Not a list of local collectors or a way to identify materials from a photo.

title: E-Waste Service: drop boxes for small electronic waste
scope_note: An example of a battery route through drop boxes. Confirm which types and conditions they accept. Pickup has its own requirements and isn't a nationwide service.

title: Health-care waste
region: Global; local rules and collectors apply
scope_note: Principles for separating infectious and medical waste and the risks of handling it. Not a promise that a particular health facility will accept it.

title: Non-hazardous materials and waste management hierarchy
scope_note: Principles for reuse, recycling and composting, and non-hazardous residual waste. Not proof that any facility in Indonesia accepts an item.

title: Composting At Home
scope_note: Composting principles and the limits on accepted materials. Confirm that your local program accepts the specific organic scraps.

title: Preventing Wasted Food At Home
scope_note: Planning and storage habits that prevent food waste. Advice for next time, not a food safety check of the item in front of you.

title: E-Waste
scope_note: Electronic waste collection in Jakarta. Other regions need their own official collector.
